source.mesh_rectification_note: mesh verts rotated about Y by this angle into skeleton space; 0 = already aligned
source.rig_front_note: rig facing from bilateral naming; muscle "front" offsets use this direction

fat.note: Per-region subcutaneous fat thickness. Morph params scale these baselines; the skin rides muscle+fat via bake_displacement.

skin.note: The skin layer IS the character mesh (referenced). MPFB shape keys stay the surface-morph path; anatomy morphs bake to per-vertex displacement along normals.
